events.title: 300 New Bunny Designs! A Bigger Collection, Tidier Shelves
events.summary: Hey everyone! 🐰 Your feedback has helped shape a big update for Sort The Bunnies: 300 new bunny designs, bringing the collection from 200 to 500! That's 2.5 times the variety, with new designs created to fit the game's existing themes. Returning demo players: please read the save information below. Your previous shelf arrangement may change. events.title: Online Co-op Is Here! Try the Demo Together. Launching October 27
events.summary: We have a big update for you: online co-op is now available in Sort The Bunnies, and you can play it in the free demo right now! Bring your friends to the shop Play solo for a quiet sorting session, or join your friends online and bring order to the shop together. Find the right bunny figurines, carry them to their matching shelves, complete colorful collections, and earn money for helpful upgrades. events.title: A Little Surprise at the End!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We’ve added a little surprise at the end of Sort The Bunnies! If you finished the game before this update, we’d love for you to hop back in and check it out. No spoilers here — we’ll leave the discovery to you. Thanks for playing and for all your support!
